description: Ask for an authority (a law, regulation, standard or policy) to be added to the NOMOS Exchange when find_authority finds nothing. Requests are public and ranked by how many asked; they decide what is compiled next. Repeated requests from one caller count once. This never creates an authority: only its issuer, or NOMOS compiling the public text, can.

source_url.description: Optional link to the official text.

title.description: The authority by its usual name, e.g. "UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law 45/2021)".

name: request_authority
